summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of a Chilean Material Information letter to the CMF and local exchanges concerning its own local-market debt placement. On November 2, 2026 the bank placed Serie FT senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds registered under CMF Securities Registry number 11/2022, totaling UF 684,000 (CLF 684,000), maturing October 1, 2032, at an average placement rate of 2.93%. No equity, ownership, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is implicated; this is ordinary funding activity, not a special situation. Watch only refinancing mix and cost of funds.
